model.rnn_reset: zero h+c at every episode reset
model.normalization: checkpoint normalizer via prepare_and_normalize_obs in eval mode
model.evaluation_frame_skip: Each original case specification, including eight-tick OOD
model.render_contract: native 160x120 HUD-on expert; separate standard 320x240 text environment

expert_collection_policy.observation: standard 320x240 HUD-off visible labels, player variables and existing short history
expert_collection_policy.expert_input: native 160x120 HUD-on RGB, nearest resize to 128x72, recurrent state reset per episode

definitions.weighting: equal weight per recorded Basic decision; correlated states within episodes
definitions.probabilities: float64 stable log-softmax of saved T=1 logits; no probability floor
definitions.hard_target: original APPO argmax, with lexicographic tie breaking; not epsilon exploration action
definitions.soft_target: original normalized APPO policy distribution from the common soft export
definitions.soft_kl: KL(expert || student); only tiny negative roundoff is clamped to zero
definitions.vector_brier: sum over every offered action, without dividing by candidate count
definitions.ece: 15 equal-width top-label confidence bins on [0,1], final bin includes 1; correctness means expert-argmax agreement
definitions.scope: Offline action-policy fit on common expert-visited states, not probability-of-winning calibration or closed-loop game performance
definitions.selection: none; no fitting, temperature calibration or checkpoint selection by this script
definitions.ignored_fields: Each run's training_target, gold_index, teacher_probs and gold_probs are not used as evaluation targets
